test_title: PYST 51: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

My apartment / in Delhi / is situated / on second floor.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4. "on second floor".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The segment **"on second floor"** is missing the definite article "**the**" before "second floor."
 
• In English, when referring to floors within a building, the definite article "the" is used, e.g., "the first floor," "the second floor."
 
• The **correct **phrase should be **"on the second floor."**

Therefore, the correct sentence is- *My apartment in Delhi is situated on the second floor.*
